preheader: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 with interactive UI, and the Fed blames the AI data center boom for high prices.

lead.headline: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-6 with Interactive 'Intelligent UI' to All Users
lead.body: OpenAI has started releasing GPT-6 to all ChatGPT users, including those on free plans. The update features an 'Intelligent UI' that mixes text with interactive graphics, buttons, and charts. It can also build functional tools like calculators and games on the fly.
lead.why: As a business student, you can use these interactive tools to quickly build prototypes for class projects or startup ideas without needing to write code.

figures.label: since paid users first got GPT-6

stories.headline: Federal Reserve Blames AI Data Center Boom for Keeping Prices High
stories.body: Minutes from the Fed's September meeting show that officials see the massive buildout of AI data centers as a major force keeping goods prices elevated. This infrastructure boom is currently putting more upward pressure on prices than tariffs.
stories.why: High inflation means the Fed might keep interest rates higher for longer. This makes borrowing more expensive for startups and can lower valuations for tech investments.

stories.headline: Amazon Cuts More Jobs in Customer Service and Engineering
stories.body: Amazon has laid off employees across several divisions, including seller support, engineering, and customer service. The cuts are part of an ongoing cost overhaul as the company shifts resources toward AI investments.
stories.why: It shows that even the biggest tech firms are trading traditional corporate roles for AI infrastructure, meaning you should focus on strategic skills that AI cannot easily replicate.

stories.headline: Microsoft Launches $2,599 Surface Laptop Powered by Nvidia AI Chips
stories.body: Microsoft announced pricing for its new Surface Laptop Ultra, which starts at $2,599 and runs on Nvidia RTX Spark chips. The company claims the laptop outperforms Apple's MacBook Pro on tasks that run AI models locally.
stories.why: This marks a shift toward 'hybrid intelligence' where AI tasks are processed directly on your device rather than in the cloud, opening up new possibilities for offline software startups.

stories.headline: Chinese AI Startup DeepSeek Targets $15 Billion in Mega Funding Round
stories.body: DeepSeek is considering doubling its latest funding round to 100 billion yuan, or about $14.9 billion. The startup has drawn heavy interest from state-backed funds and corporate venture arms in China.
stories.why: The sheer scale of this funding shows how capital-intensive foundation AI models are, highlighting why many venture capitalists are shifting their focus to practical AI applications instead.

stories.headline: McKinsey Chair Says AI Productivity Could Help Ease US National Debt
stories.body: Eric Kutcher, chair of McKinsey North America, argued that AI is the country's best hope for boosting productivity and lifting economic growth. However, he warned that energy constraints could limit the expansion of the data centers needed to power this growth.
stories.why: Understanding how macro trends like national debt intersect with technology is exactly the kind of structured thinking you will need to demonstrate in consulting case interviews.

stories.headline: McKinsey Data Questions Whether AI Spending Will Actually Boost Profits
stories.body: Recent McKinsey data reveals that only 37% of companies expect to see earnings gains from AI by 2026, and 40% do not plan to increase their AI spending. This raises questions about whether the current corporate spending boom on AI is sustainable.
stories.why: As an aspiring investor, this data reminds you to look past market hype and focus on whether a company's technology investments are actually driving bottom-line profits.

stories.headline: UCI Men's Basketball to Host UNM Lobos on December 18
stories.body: The UC Irvine men's basketball team is scheduled to host the UNM Lobos on December 18 before heading to the SoCal Challenge. College basketball analysts view this matchup as a highly pivotal game for both teams' seasons.

stories.headline: Novak Djokovic Wins China Open for His 102nd Career Title
stories.body: Novak Djokovic claimed his 102nd career singles title on Tuesday after his opponent, Alex de Minaur, retired due to an injury during the final match in Beijing. The 39-year-old tennis star credited his victory to his persistent spirit.

term.name: Capital Expenditure (CapEx)
term.definition: CapEx is the money a company spends to buy, maintain, or improve physical assets like buildings, machinery, or technology infrastructure. In today's news, analysts are questioning whether the massive CapEx boom in AI data centers will actually generate enough corporate profit to justify the cost.

serve.headline: Siena raised $17M to build AI agents for consumer brands
serve.body: Siena, a New York-based startup, raised $17 million in a Series A funding round led by York IE. The company builds autonomous AI agents designed to handle customer service and interactions for consumer brands.
questions: How can consumer brands use AI agents to improve customer service without losing the human touch?
If you were launching a startup at UCI, would you build AI agents for a niche industry or target broad consumer brands?
How does a $17 million Series A change a startup's pressure to deliver immediate revenue?
